function.name: give_up
function.arguments: {"reason": "Three grasp attempts all failed the same way: closing the gripper ejects the 4.5 cm block out of the finger gap along the finger-length direction, leaving it on the table beside the closed fingers with the measured opening at 0.016 (air close). The block was localized near x=-0.178, y~0.0 and the pads were aligned over it, but I could not convert alignment into a hold within the decision budget, and with the decisions remaining a grasp plus lift plus transport plus release was no longer reachable.", "hindsight": "Rig facts: table at z=0.80; block is a ~4.5 cm cube; blue bowl sits ~7-9 cm from the block along +y at nearly the same x. eef_pos reads about 1.4 cm above the fingertip pads (pads at block mid-height when measured z is ~0.836); the z servo converges slowly, only ~1 cm per decision, and a commanded z of 0.82 settles near measured 0.85. Wrist camera: image-right is +x and image-up is +y, but pixel offsets underestimate true offsets by roughly 2x, so confirm with the fixed side/front cameras. Critical lesson: after closing, check the measured gripper value - holding the block reads ~0.3-0.5, while 0.016 means the pads closed on air and the block was ejected; closing while descending from the fully open 7.5 cm gap repeatedly pushed the block out instead of gripping it."}
